newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy acquires 3 Argentine rigs.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy acquires 3 Argentine rigs.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Friday it has acquired three drilling rigs in Argentina from DI Industries Inc for $1.5 million in cash.
The rigs are undergoing refurbishment and will be operated by Servicios WellTech SA, Key Energy's 63 percent owned Argentine well servicing subsidiary.

The three rigs are 700 horsepower mechanical rigs with a rated depth of 8,500 feet. The purchase includes pumps, handling equipment and drillpipe/collars necessary to drill to the rated depth, in addition to a quantity of additional equipment useful in the drilling and workover businesses.

"We anticipate that our added capability in Argentina, in addition to an improved outlook (there) and our recent cost cutting measures, may produce improved financial results over the course of the next few quarters," Key Energy chief executive Francis D. John said.
